name: hireflow-ats
description: HireFlow - Full-Stack Applicant Tracking and Recruitment Platform

scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const s = spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev', '--prefix', 'server'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); const c = spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev', '--prefix', 'client'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); process.on('SIGINT', () => { s.kill(); c.kill(); process.exit(); });"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
